fixed_meta_decision.guidance: Use the past training evidence to improve both future search and self-revision.

fixed_meta_plan.expected_effect: On the exact matched archive, slot 0 changes from construct with no parent to mutate with the first archived parent, and evidence order changes; slot 1 may change from mutate to crossover with two parents; meta changes from revise to repair and reorders evidence. This should prioritize the best feasible search path while keeping the infeasible case visible.
fixed_meta_plan.falsification: The revision would be falsified if the exact matched inputs produce no task decision change in operator, parents, evidence or rule index, if meta remains revise with unchanged evidence, or if repair or crossover yields no feasible improvement over the prior fixed-b/01 evidence in future evaluation.
fixed_meta_plan.mechanism_change: Rank evidence IDs from context evidence by feasible score, placing the best feasible first and infeasible cases next; when parents exist, use mutate on slot 0 and crossover on slot 1 if two parents are available; set meta mode to repair when any supplied evidence is infeasible, otherwise rethink when the best feasible score is less than half the next feasible score.
fixed_meta_plan.observed_problem: Training evidence shows fixed-a/01 is infeasible while fixed-b/01 is the best feasible case at 116.46 ms versus fixed-b/00 at 296.74 and fixed-a/00 at 201.02. The current generator ignores this: it always constructs on even slots, takes the first three evidence IDs, and always uses revise for meta, so the infeasible case and best feasible parent do not steer the next search.
